description.en: Original nominal55cm interpretive rock cut-section: opposing solid rock surfaces have complementary irregular primary and secondary dissolution teeth extending into depth along a continuous narrow seam. The actual interlocking interface and deliberately legible display gap remain readable in gray; no black painted zigzag, random fracture pile, measured stress/pressure direction or locality asserted. Cut outer faces are teaching section boundaries, not an added display plinth.
description.zh: 原创名义55厘米教学岩体裁切剖面：两侧实岩沿连续窄缝以不规则主次溶蚀齿互补嵌合，齿面真实入体；真实互锁界面与为可读性适度夸张的展示细缝在灰模可见。非黑色锯齿贴线/随机碎裂堆，不推定实测应力压力方向地点；外裁面为教学剖切边界，不另加展示底座。
